sentences.text:
Rajesh Kumar Sharma And Another vs State Of U.P. And
Another on 6 January, 2025

Author: Samit Gopal
Bench: Samit Gopal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:2522
Court No. - 78
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 17256 of 2022
Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Sharma And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Upadhyay,Vinod Kumar Upadhyay

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Ajay Dubey,Satya Dheer Singh Jadaun,Tej Bhan Singh
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
List revised.

2. Heard Sri Vinod Kumar Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicants, Jairaj holding brief of Sri Ajay Dubey, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2, Sri Ajay Singh, learned AGA-I for the State and perused the records.

3. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Rajesh Kumar Sharma and Smt. Savita Sharma with the prayer to allow the present application and quash the entire criminal proceeding criminal case no. 1230 of 2022 (State of U.P. Vs. Narendra Kumar and Rajesh Kumar Sharma And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99739839/
1 others) arising out of charge sheet dated 09.09.2021 under Sections 498A, 323, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act filed in Case Crime No. 634 of 2019 Police Station New Agra, District Agra and with the further prayer to stay the further proceedings of aforesaid case, during the pendency of present application.
4.

entities.text: State of U.P. Vs. Narendra Kumar and Rajesh Kumar Sharma And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The matter was referred to the Mediation Centre of this Court vide order dated 6.1.2023 for making an effort between the parties for settling their disputes amicably.
5. As per the office report dated 12.4.2023, a report from the Mediation Centre of this Court is on record.
6. As per report of Mediation Centre dated 23.3.2023, the parties have amicably settled their dispute and further agreed to withdraw the cases going on between them.
and further they have decided to live separately since November, 2018.

7. From perusal of the report of Mediation Centre of this Court, it appears that in pursuance of the said order the mediation proceedings were taken up which ended in a settlement between the parties and the Mediation succeeded.
The parties have settled their grievances and even the dispute arising in the present matter.
The parties have agreed that they shall not file any fresh case against each other, the said fact is mentioned in para 7 (j) of the said mediation report.

The affidavit of compliance dated 25.4.2023 has been placed before the Court to demonstrate through annexure no.2 in para 8 that Rs.32,00,000/- has been received by the wife-opposite party no.2.
8.

The law with regards to quashing of a case on the basis of settlement arrived between the parties,
is well settled.

The Apex Court in the cases of (1) B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another: (2003)4 SCC 675; (2) Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation : (2008) 9 SCC 677; (3) Manoj Sharma Vs. State and others: ( 2008) 16 SCC 1; (4) Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab:
(2012) 10 SCC 303; (5) Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. And another: 2013 (83) ACC 278 and (6) Parbatbhai Ahir@Parbatbhai @ Bhimsinbhai Karmur and others Vs. State of Gujarat and another: (2017) 9 SCC 641 has held that the cases in which the parties have settled their grievances can be quashed.
9.

sentences.text:
From perusal of the records and the law laid down by the Apex Court on the subject matter, the present case is a good case for exercising powers by this Court to quash the proceedings as prayed for by the applicant(s).
10.
The present application is allowed.

11. The entire proceedings of the aforesaid case as well as Charge Sheet in the aforesaid case are hereby quashed subject to the applicant (s) depositing Rs.10,000/- before the concerned trial court which shall be utilized by the District Legal Services Authority of the district.
(Samit Gopal, J.)
Order Date :- 6.1.2025
Gaurav Kuls
